Staff will learn the standard that applies

Companion Animal Travel Desk Service Standard
This section sets the daily standard for careful, calm handling of companion animal travel from booking through pickup.

Use clear language with travelers and confirm the animal's needs before any reservation is accepted. Keep records complete, note special handling, and review carrier fit, temperament, and routing before final confirmation. <<FACT F091>> All staff must avoid assumptions and must escalate concerns at once when a plan appears incomplete or unsafe.

During check-in, verify documents, carrier condition, and the animal's readiness for travel. <<FACT F098>> If a traveler arrives with missing items, explain the issue in a direct and respectful manner and pause processing until the matter is resolved. Support the traveler with concise instructions and maintain a composed tone throughout.

For boarding, confirm the approved plan, watch for signs of stress, and coordinate any required handoff without delay. <<FACT F105>> Do not improvise changes outside the approved file, and do not leave a traveler uncertain about next steps. If the animal or carrier no longer meets the standard, return the case to review before release.

When service is complete, document the outcome, note any concerns, and ensure the traveler understands pickup arrangements. Keep the Companion Animal Travel Desk prepared for the next case by resetting supplies and closing open records promptly.

For further direction, contact the senior coordinator on duty.
